title: Automated Ableism: An Exploration of Explicit Disability Biases in Sentiment and Toxicity Analysis Models

bias_targets.methodology: Perturbation Sensitivity Analysis using the Bias Identification Test in Sentiment (BITS) corpus. The authors substitute neutral or non-disability terms with clinical and social disability-related terms in sentence templates and evaluate explicit bias by measuring changes in sentiment and toxicity scores using metrics like ScoreSense, ScoreDev, and LabelDistance.
